reasons.claim: A single chain of five links ends at the Companion who reports the Prophet's curse.
reasons.quote: عن عبد الرحمن بن عبد الله بن مسعود، عن ابن مسعود، قال لعن رسول الله

reasons.claim: The «وفي الباب» list and the grading are the compiler's remarks, not routes.
reasons.quote: قال وفي الباب عن عمر وعلي

reasons.claim: The chain opens with the compiler's father and runs by «عن» to the Imam who speaks.
reasons.quote: عَنْ مَيْمُونٍ الْبَانِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الصَّادِقِ ع قَالَ

reasons.claim: «أخيه علي» is one link, written by the name.
Anas is asked and answers in his own words, so he is the last link (rulings 2 and 3); the stored chain wrongly stops at Thabit.
A single chain of seven transmitters ends at the Imam who speaks; footnote marks are not part of names.
reasons.quote: عن عمار ابن أبي اليقظان (٢) عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام قال

reasons.claim: Two «ح» branches, each with two co-transmitters, meet at the shared tail written once.
reasons.quote: كلاهما عن أبي الزناد، عن الأعرج، عن أبي هريرة

reasons.claim: «يعنيان الحزامي» is a gloss, and the Zuhayr/Amr notes are wording remarks, not routes.
reasons.quote: وفي حديث زهير يبلغ به النبي

reasons.claim: Three heads meet at Yahya, and the chain continues once to Ibn Umar.
Qawariri's wording restates the same Yahya and the same tail; it adds no new route.
reasons.quote: قال القواريري حدثني يحيى بن سعيد، عن عبيد الله بن، عمر حدثني نافع، عن ابن عمر

reasons.claim: Ubayd Allah b. Sa'id's note changes only the door, so it is a wording remark.
reasons.quote: وقال عبيد الله بن سعيد في روايته

reasons.claim: Nafi' describes Ibn Umar's practice; a man whose practice is only told is not a link (ruling 4), so the chain ends at Nafi'.
reasons.quote: عن نافع، أن ابن عمر  رضى الله عنهما  كان يبيت

reviews.uncertainty_note: Nafi' plausibly saw the practice himself, but Ibn Umar never speaks, so under ruling 4 he stays out.

reasons.claim: The first branch has four co-transmitters from Waki' to Ibn Abi Awfa; «قال يحيى» names the same Yahya.
reasons.quote: قال يحيى أخبرنا وكيع، عن شعبة، عن عمرو بن مرة

reasons.claim: The second branch runs through Ubayd Allah's father to the same Companion.
reasons.quote: حدثنا أبي، عن شعبة، عن عمرو، - وهو ابن مرة - حدثنا عبد الله بن أبي أوفى

reasons.claim: A single chain ends at Jabir, who reports the Prophet's prohibition; the stored chain wrongly takes matn words as names.
reasons.quote: عن عطاء بن أبي رباح، عن جابر بن عبد الله
